title.en: Tool Schema Design — Naming, Descriptions, Parameter Constraints

hook: A correct tool fails silently when the model cannot tell when to use it. Naming, descriptions, and parameter shapes drive 10 to 20 percentage-point swings in tool-selection accuracy on benchmarks like StableToolBench and MCPToolBench++. This lesson names the design rules that separate a tool a model picks reliably from a tool a model mis-fires.
